actions.description: Adds an attachment to an issue.

actions.description: Retrieves an attachment from an issue.

actions.description: Adds a new watcher to an issue.

actions.name: update_issue_comment
actions.description: Updates a comment to a specific issue.

actions.description: Returns all comments for an issue.

actions.description: Deletes a comment on a specific issue.

actions.description: Convert Markdown-formatted text to Jira's ADF syntax for use in comments and descriptions etc

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_issue
triggers.description: Triggers when a new issue is created

triggers.name: updated_issue
triggers.description: Triggers when an issue is updated

triggers.name: updated_issue_status
triggers.description: Triggers when an issue status is updated

triggers.name: new_comment
triggers.description: Fires whenever someone adds a new comment to a Jira issue. Great for getting notified in Slack or Teams, syncing customer replies, or reacting to feedback automatically.

triggers.name: issue_assigned
triggers.description: Fires when a Jira issue is assigned to someone. Use it to ping people in Slack/Teams the moment work lands on them, auto-create a to-do when tickets hit your queue, or track hand-offs between teammates.

triggers.name: new_attachment
triggers.description: Fires when a file is attached to a Jira issue. Great for auto-saving screenshots to Google Drive, forwarding customer uploads to support tools, or archiving documents in S3.

triggers.name: new_issue_type
triggers.description: Triggers when a new issue type is created in a project

triggers.name: new_project
triggers.description: Triggers when a new project is created

triggers.name: new_priority
triggers.description: Triggers when a new priority is created
